source_spans.quote: a. The purpose of this subchapter is to provide guidance regarding the use of information request letters (IRLs) and information notices (INs).

claim_judgments.rationale: C0000 accurately states the purpose of subchapter 8 FAM 801.2 as providing guidance on the use of IRLs and INs, directly reflecting the source text.

source_spans.quote: b. IRLs are personalized, standardized letters with a date and signature block that request from the applicant additional information, documentation, or action needed to process the passport application. You must fully adjudicate the application prior to suspending to ensure that you are addressing all issues. The IRLs have been carefully crafted to communicate clearly and accurately statutory, regulatory, and other requirements of the Department.

claim_judgments.rationale: C0001 faithfully defines IRLs as personalized, standardized letters with date and signature blocks requesting additional info, docs, or action needed to process a passport application.

source_spans.quote: (1) Passport agencies/centers must not make unilateral changes or alterations to the IRLs without the approval of the Office of Adjudication (CA/PPT/S/A) except on a case-by-case basis with the approval of passport agency/center management in extenuating circumstances, e.g., when you request that the applicant submit a birth certificate instead of a notification of birth registration, and the applicant insists that the notification of birth registration is the birth certificate; and

claim_judgments.rationale: C0004 completely covers the prohibition on unilateral changes/alterations by passport agencies/centers without CA/PPT/S/A approval, as well as the extenuating circumstances case-by-case exception with agency/center management approval.

source_spans.quote: (2) Posts must use the cleared language in the IRLs, but are authorized to modify the language to suit local logistical requirements and other local concerns such as available documentation.

claim_judgments.rationale: C0005 accurately states the requirement that Posts must use the cleared language in the IRLs.

source_spans.quote: NOTE : IRLs are not adjudicative guidance. The passport application must be adjudicated in accordance with the 8 FAM and then the appropriate IRL selected to address any deficiencies with the passport or Consular Report of Birth Abroad (CRBA)

claim_judgments.rationale: C0008 captures the sequential requirement that the passport application must be adjudicated in accordance with 8 FAM prior to selecting the appropriate IRL to address deficiencies.

source_spans.quote: c. INs are standardized notices that provide passport bearers with information about their passports. For example, an IN may be included to explain why the passport was limited in validity, and/or what documentation is needed to obtain a fully valid passport. The INs have been carefully crafted to communicate this information clearly and accurately. Consequently, no changes or alterations to the INs may be made unilaterally at passport agencies/centers without the approval of CA/PPT/S/A except in extenuating circumstances on a case-by-case basis with the approval of passport agency/center management, e.g., when using an endorsement 46 to limit a passport for a special problem. INs do not require a response from the applicant and do not need to be personalized with the applicant's name and address.

claim_judgments.rationale: C0009 captures the baseline definition that INs are standardized notices providing passport bearers with information about their passports.
